probe_01.description: First five-second digital capture: both inputs flat while both TimeSticks failed PPS register reads. Not a synchronization measurement.

probe_02.description: Fifteen-second startup capture after full assembly power cycle. Contains PI acquisition and identifies channel roles. Not a steady-state run.
probe_02.mapping_evidence: CH0 steps backward in clock phase and its physical recovery matches the follower offset trace. CH1 has a nearly constant PPS period.

recovery: Saleae firmware transfer initially timed out; reconnecting its USB cable restored enumeration. Full UNO/shield/TimeStick power cycling restored clock initialization and PPS. No firmware was changed in this session.
